command:
set -uo pipefail
mkdir -p p19-output
id | tee p19-output/identity.txt
uname -a | tee p19-output/kernel.txt
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then echo root_identity_refused | tee p19-output/inner-exit.txt; exit 1; fi
python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/p19-venv"
"$RUNNER_TEMP/p19-venv/bin/python" -m pip install pytest pytest-timeout jsonschema referencing > p19-output/setup.log 2>&1
setup_exit=$?
printf 'setup=%s\n' "$setup_exit" > p19-output/inner-exit.txt
if [ "$setup_exit" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$setup_exit"; fi
cd runtime
"$RUNNER_TEMP/p19-venv/bin/python" -m pytest -q tests/test_lifecycle_transfer_transport.py::test_received_alias_keeps_same_lock_after_sender_closes 2>&1 | tee ../p19-output/pytest.log
proof_exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
printf 'pytest=%s\n' "$proof_exit" >> ../p19-output/inner-exit.txt
sha256sum ../p19-output/*.txt ../p19-output/*.log > ../p19-output/SHA256SUMS
exit "$proof_exit"
